caption:
On YouTube since 2006, and GTA 6 just made me start from zero 🤯

Nobody knows how big this game is going to get. Story mode, free roam, online... it's all a mystery. So instead of cramming it into my old channel, I'm building a brand new home for it 🏗️🔥

Would you start over for GTA 6? Tell me in the comments 👇

13 years. Countless sunset drives through Los Santos. One radio station that was always there 📻💔

Non-Stop-Pop FM was never just background music. It was the soundtrack to our late nights, our chaos, our quiet drives home. And now it's time to say goodbye… 🌅

Vice City is calling, but a part of us is staying right here 🥲

Which GTA 5 radio station carried YOUR memories? Tell me below 👇

That weight of expectation? Finally gone 🪶

Two channels, two vibes: story mode and thug life on one, every wild experiment and random idea on the other 🎮💥 No pressure now. I'm just playing the game and having fun again.

Creators, you know this feeling. Tag someone who needs to hear it 💯

13 YEARS of GTA 5. Let that sink in 😳

Channel made in 2006. A whole new one today. Next stop: GTA 6, the newest member of the Rockstar family 🌴🚗 Who knows how long we'll be playing this one... but I'm SO ready.
